title: Vitali covering for Hⁿ by closed discs in an n-plane
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let W be a linear subspace of ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with dim W = n, and Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^N. Let ι be a type, S ⊆ W an arbitrary (not necessarily measurable) set, t ⊆ ι, c : ι → ℝ^N and ρ : ι → ℝ such that c(i) ∈ W and ρ(i) > 0 for every i ∈ t, and suppose the family is fine at S: for every x ∈ S and ε > 0 there is i ∈ t with c(i) = x and ρ(i) ≤ ε. Then there is a countable u ⊆ t such that the sets D_i := W ∩ B̄(c(i), ρ(i)) (i ∈ u) are pairwise disjoint as an indexed family (D_i ∩ D_k = ∅ for distinct i, k ∈ u) and Hⁿ(S ∖ ⋃_{i∈u} D_i) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ (ι : Type) (S : Set (Rn N)) (t : Set ι) (c : ι → Rn N) (ρ : ι → ℝ), S ⊆ (W : Set (Rn N)) → (∀ i ∈ t, c i ∈ W ∧ 0 < ρ i) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ i ∈ t, c i = x ∧ ρ i ≤ ε) → ∃ u ⊆ t, u.Countable ∧ u.PairwiseDisjoint (fun i ↦ (W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall (c i) (ρ i)) ∧ μHE[n] (S \ ⋃ i ∈ u, ((W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall (c i) (ρ i))) = 0
